  • Viju Industry Nigeria Limited, a leading firm in the beverage production industry

     

    Quality Assurance

    • Job Type Full Time , Onsite
    • Qualification BA/BSc/HND
    • Experience 3 - 5 years
    • Location Abuja , Ogun
    • Job Field Manufacturing 
    • Salary Range ₦150,000 - ₦200,000/month

    About job

    • The position is mainly responsible for conducting laboratory tests and analyses on beverage samples, ensuring that all indicators meet quality standards, and issuing detailed testing and analysis reports.
    • In addition, the analyst is required to regularly enter the production workshop to collect samples for inspection, thereby safeguarding the stability and safety of products during the manufacturing process.
    • We expect candidates to possess solid laboratory operation skills, be familiar with standard testing methods, and be able to independently complete sample analysis and data recording.
    • Attention to detail, rigor, and a strong sense of responsibility are essential qualities for this role.

    Check how your CV matches this job

    Method of Application

    Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: vijutalent@gmail.com using the position as subject of email.
